description: Analyses a wallet the way walletprofit.app does: total value, holdings, liquidity (LP) positions with fee rates and range status, lending positions net of debt, and all-time profit. EVM addresses (0x… or an ENS name) are read on every supported chain at once; Solana and Bitcoin addresses too. A wallet not analysed recently can take a minute or more: if the answer says it is still running, call again with the same address. Results are kept 15 minutes.
